senses.definition: A harpist, especially one who plays a traditional harp without pedals.

quotes.text:
The Harpe. […]
 A harper with his wreſt maye tune the harpe wrong
 Mys tunying of an Inſtrument ſhal hurt a true ſonge
quotes.reference: 1568, William Cornishe [i.e., William Cornysh], “In the Fleete Made by Me William Cornishe otherwise Called Nyshwhete Chapelman with the Most Famose and Noble Kyng Henry the VII. senses.definition: (obsolete) An old Irish brass coin bearing the emblem of a harp.

quotes.text: the harper that was gathered amongst us to pay the piper
